craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of sudden means; vyabhicāri vismayotsāha at impossible-yet-done. Sanskrit-first: yadi-tataḥ-katham (IF-THEN-HOW — staged perplexity kept per UNC, never resolved); jhaṭiti (SUDDENLY — kept; suddenness IS the means). Rows: 1 (‘first means’ closes — prathama-upāya last), 7 declined — no vocative; question IS the address. Close: ‘the first means’. Rupture: line-break (perplexity turns to bowing — unhymnable, yet hymned). Rejected: resolving perplexity — killed: staged is the show; ‘method’ for means — killed: upāya kept means (house word). Read aloud: IF the-HEART al-READ-y HOLDS-his-CON-duct, HOW-sing AT-all … YET it-IS-hymned, SUDD-en-ly: BOW to-ŚI-va-ONE-ness, the-FIRST-means.

lines: If the heart already holds His conduct, how sing at all?
Yet it is hymned, suddenly: bow to Śiva-oneness, the first means.
l4.sanskrit_cite: hṛdayam adhiśete yadi tataḥ | kathaṃ stotraṃ kuryād | śivaikātmyaprāptau śivanatir upāyaḥ prathamakaḥ

reads_against.argmap: If the heart holds His conduct, how hymn — and by what means? → Held conduct unhymnable yet hymned: sudden Śiva-bowing, first means.
c1_essence: Unhymnable held, hymned sudden: bowing first means.
